dialogues.speaker: Vino
variants: I can smell the sea salt... and feel a chilling breeze. We have entered the forgotten memory world.
The salt air and the cold wind… we've stepped into a memory frozen in time.
This place reeks of the sea and regret. The memory is strong here.

dialogues.speaker: Echo
variants: This is Mang Tomas' memory, Vino. A world frozen in time. The black fog of oblivion covers the paths.
You stand in Mang Tomas' past. Time has stopped. The black fog hides the truth.
Mang Tomas' memories are trapped here. Shadows of oblivion block the way.

dialogues.speaker: Vino
variants: I must look for clues and talk to the villagers to reconstruct the truth.
I need to gather pieces of the past. The villagers hold the answers.
To uncover what happened, I must speak with the people of this memory.
